description: Mynt's treasury template (workspaces/coding-build/templates/solana-treasury) as CI's solana-treasury job builds it: verifiably, in Anchor's pinned image, with Mynt's own build script. program_sha256 is the sha256 of the program's bytes with trailing zero bytes stripped, the way Mynt hashes a build and a deployed program. CI fails when the build doesn't match, so a change to the template, its Cargo.lock or the toolchain needs a review and a new hash here. Devnet only: the mainnet program gate refuses this program, and nothing reads this file to allow it yet.
